specification_assessment: Coherent dependency-ready internal authorization/history/redemption/private-transfer scope. Two separately owned immutable tables soft-join original graph with sealed public UUID/hash facts; no purchase/source authority is inferred from byte descriptors or copied inputs.
engineering_assessment: Feasible with existing SourceV2/Commands raw receipts, optional exact Rows/schema/config admission and new fixed Records specs. Critical callback-order/time/cleanup/availability gaps in initial contract are explicitly resolved in final design.
conditions: This approves only design feasibility at exact9a3, not source implementation, migration execution, passing tests, native concurrency, HTTP composition or final development/merge acceptance.

Implement literal optional delivery config/key/schema state separate from retained purchase policy; all new table access requires completed admission and own Records specs. Keep old five-table/frozen profiles/V1/shared code unchanged.

Bound every current selector: exact account/request, authorization public UUID and origin UUID/hash/target, recent authorization limit4 for three-per60s, history20 and all current origin attempts up to policy100 plus sentinel. Capture post-DML expected attempt state in original receipt; do not reuse first-frame counters as current authority.

Idempotent authorization replay remains subject to current owner/purpose/key, unchanged request/origin/batch/target and unexpired/unspent admission; it must not resurrect an expired/spent row or silently replace its token hash.
Exact token/key/config proof covers selected callback drift; does not claim a general key-rotation/revocation policy or repair unwrapped V1/identity metadata P2s.

Before-chunk authority boundary is private chunk handoff to trusted consumer; future HTTP/mount must independently retain the same no-callback-after-proof path to actual write, privacy/error handling and host/proxy time conditions.

Transfer/request capabilities reject bypass construction/serialization/cloning/replay; pre-proof/cancel/never-started disposal abandons original observer and descriptor, including after policy/budget drift, preserves initial failure and durable/unrelated work.

Native currentness/uniqueness under actual supported isolation, duplicate authorization/redemption/final-limit races, exact permanent engine/temp refusal and populated old/new schema restart/refusal require source-bound executions. No missing-API baseline may be labelled behavioral oracle.

Snapshot availability lease covers original admitted phase (max660 or phase+60, cap1860), not authority. This key coordinates actual participating document/new snapshot paths; unchanged V1 snapshot code is not silently claimed to acquire it. All-family spool capacity, uninterruptible-I/O overlap and distributed-cache semantics remain host conditions.

Frozen PDF verify/copyVerified calls are bounded/checkable, not interruptible; use exact retained targets and admitted arrays, enforce pure live checks before/after and own copy/readback. Close only owned temp/descriptors/leases, never original paths/replacements.

Private whole SQLite/affected family/V1 and focused owned native evidence, Pint/CI-policy checks, independent tested-source/final packet decision, cheap exact-head preflight/protections and expected-SHA merge remain required. Keep all flags default-off and HTTP/root/live/provider/commercial/release conditions open.
Preserve sharedV1/identity metadata and ordinary-membership afterCommit P2s for their related batches. No scope expansion or idle-PDO commit inference.
